pages.title: The First Hammer Blow
pages.text: Check the forge tier. Place the main ingredient in the center and the other ingredients on pedestals. Add required enhancers and essences, then use a Blacksmith Gavel on the forge. Most rituals take 25 seconds.

pages.title: Enhancer Relics
pages.text: The forge's small slots hold enhancer relics. Different relics provide different benefits.
Use a Blacksmith Gavel to start the ritual. Gavels made from other materials work too.
